snippet.title: Micro Machines (NES) Gameplay 240p | No Commentary - Camerica, 1991 (Original Hardware, Composite)
snippet.description:
Micro Machines was released for Nintendo's classic 8-bit NES console in  1991. All audio/visual elements copyright 1991, Camerica. Music composed by ?

This video was produced for NESguide.com - a website that attempts to organize the NES catalog and make it easy to explore. Gameplays from this channel are featured throughout the NESguide website to showcase the original basic mechanics and audio/visual design of each title. Thank you for your continued support of this project, since 2007!


ABOUT MICRO MACHINES (NES)

The first game in the series laid the foundation of the gameplay: a top-down racing game with miniature vehicles. The tracks were themed very differently, races take place on a billiard table or in a garden.
